title: Response
description: pcs.v2 public response envelope (J.4): {protocol_version, request_id, ok, state_revision, data, error, warnings}. error is null on success. data carries operation-specific outcome values such as committed/noop/accepted/duplicate. Unknown top-level fields are rejected.

data.description: Operation-specific result; null when the request failed without data. J.4 lists committed/noop/accepted/duplicate as examples of operation-specific outcomes, not as a closed enum.

error.description: null or a J.4 controlled error object.
